# NRC Volt Sync

> Free, local, open-source Apple Watch and Apple Health to Nike Run Club synchronization through Garmin Connect, with or without Strava. Preserves available FIT sensor data without fabricating missing GPS, heart rate, or cadence.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/nirvanasangsara-AI/nrc-volt-sync
License: MIT
Current release line: 0.3 beta
Languages: Python 3.12 and Swift 6 package / iOS 17 app
Interface: iPhone HealthKit companion, command-line application, and optional macOS LaunchAgent

## Primary use case

A runner records a run with Apple's native Workout app. The included iPhone companion writes an
authorized HealthKit run to a private Files outbox, or Strava supplies it through OAuth. NRC Volt
Sync validates the source, creates a Garmin FIT activity, checks for duplicates, uploads it to Garmin
Connect, and relies on the user's Garmin–Nike partner connection for delivery to Nike Run Club.

## Important boundaries

- This is not a hosted service and never receives users' credentials or health data.
- Nike has no public activity-import API used by this project.
- Version 0.3 includes direct Strava-free input through a user-authorized iPhone companion and
  private Files/iCloud Drive outbox; Strava remains an optional source.
- Apple does not permit macOS apps to read HealthKit data, so direct input requires the companion.
- Free Apple Personal Team profiles expire after 7 days and require weekly reinstall; no paid publisher service exists.
- Garmin access uses the unofficial community `garminconnect` client.
- Only running activities are synchronized.
- Missing sensor streams are left missing; no route or health data is invented.
- Runtime data belongs outside Git under `~/Library/Application Support/NRCVoltSync/`.

## Documentation map

- README.md: English overview, keywords, quick start, FAQ, limitations
- README.ko.md: Korean overview and quick start
- docs/SETUP.md: exact English prerequisites and first-run checklist
- docs/SETUP.ko.md: exact Korean prerequisites and first-run checklist
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: pipeline, trust boundaries, and data fidelity
- docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md: common provider and data issues
- PRIVACY.md: local data inventory and safe diagnostic sharing
- SECURITY.md: vulnerability reporting and threat boundaries
- CONTRIBUTING.md: synthetic-data and test requirements
- THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: direct dependency acknowledgements and separate licenses
- CHANGELOG.md: release history
- docs/BETA_TESTING.md: privacy-safe end-to-end beta test sequence
- docs/WITHOUT_STRAVA.md: current free alternatives and the direct Apple Health source boundary
- docs/WITHOUT_STRAVA.ko.md: Korean no-Strava guide and data-fidelity limits
- docs/HEALTHKIT_COMPANION.md: English direct-source build, setup, timing, and portable FIT guide
- docs/HEALTHKIT_COMPANION.ko.md: Korean direct-source guide
- schema/healthkit-workout-v1.schema.json: machine-readable direct-source interchange contract
- examples/healthkit-workout.synthetic.json: fabricated, privacy-safe example payload

## Verification commands

```bash
uv sync --dev
uv run coverage run -m pytest -q
uv run coverage report
uv run ruff check .
uv run nrc-volt-sync doctor
```
